title: Part Ten: Scandal and Reform: Ambrosiano to the Becciu Retrial

sections.brief: Marcinkus and Sindona (Franklin National, Banca Privata Italiana, Ambrosoli); Banco Ambrosiano's collapse 1982; IOR letters of patronage; Calvi under Blackfriars Bridge 18 June 1982, inquests 1982/1983, Rome trial acquittals 2007–2011; Geneva settlement 25 May 1984 ($240–250m, no liability); 1987 warrant and Cassation ruling on Lateran Art. 11. Figures: fig-money, fig-time

Sloane Avenue investment (Athena 2013–14, ~350m euros, Torzi 15m), Becciu's 2020 resignation, sale to Bain 2022, trial 2021–23, verdict 16 December 2023, appeal from 22 September 2025, relative nullity and renewed hearings ordered 17 March 2026, status as of October 2026 (hearing 29 October); stated positions; presumption of innocence. Figures: fig-money, fig-time

2010 seizure and AML law/AIF; Scarano 2013; Promontory review and ~4,800 account closures 2013–15; Caloia/Liuzzo 2021; Secretariat for the Economy 2014; IOR statutes 2019; Secretariat of State funds to APSA 2021 and all funds to IOR 2022; MONEYVAL 2012, 2021, 2024 (links vt5).
